title: Sega Saturn Bootleg II: On the Road
overview:
A Sega Saturn sampler disc, not for resale, packed with a look at upcoming games. Five playable demos let you try 3 Dirty Dwarves, Bug Too!, Daytona USA Championship Circuit Edition, Virtual On and Baku Baku, and video previews show off Mr. Bones, Fighting Vipers, Virtua Cop 2, Dark Savior and Sega Worldwide Soccer '97.

- 5 playable demos
- 5 video previews
